t: This is a bust of Admiral of the Fleet John Jellicoe, 1st Earl Jellicoe, sculpted by Charles Wheeler. Jellicoe commanded the Grand Fleet at the Battle of Jutland in 1916. His handling of that battle was controversial. He made no serious mistakes and the German fleet retreated to port, but the public was disappointed the Royal Navy had not won a more dramatic victory. He later served as First Sea Lord.
